name: kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox
title: kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox
headline: Kubernetes agent-sandbox: Isolated Stateful Workloads for Agents
lede: You can manage isolated, stateful, singleton workloads on Kubernetes for agent runtimes and reinforcement learning.

effects.effect: Stateful singletons fit long-lived agent sessions.
Cluster operators get a standard way to host agent runtimes.
Isolation per agent limits the damage from a bad action.

appearances.title: kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox
appearances.summary: agent-sandbox enables easy management of isolated, stateful, singleton workloads, ideal for use cases like AI agent runtimes and reinforcement learning (RL).
